newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Macraes weighting on NZSE-40 to fall.
newsitem.headline: Macraes weighting on NZSE-40 to fall.

text.p: Macraes Mining Ltd's weighting on the NZSE-40 and NZSE-30 Capital Indices will fall as a result of its decision to change its listing status, the New Zealand Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Macraes said on Tuesday that it would change its status to that of an overseas listed issuer and would remain on the official list of the Australian Stock Exchange.
Macraes ordinary shares and notes together have a 0.90 percent weighting on the NZSE-40 and the effect will be to almost halve its weighting.
For the purposes of calculating the index, 44 percent of the ordinary shares would be counted as being on the New Zealand register and 25.50 percent of the notes.
Macraes would also be removed from the Stock Exchange's Mid-Cap Index, which is for New Zealand stocks only, and replaced with construction firm Richina Pacific Ltd.
